description:
[read-only] Read-only analytics query: one `metric` aggregated (median by default) over posts, broken down by up to a few dimensions (platform, weekday, hour, brand, campaign, postType, label:<key>, arm), at a fixed post age `window` (48h / 7d / 30d / lifetime) so posts are compared fairly. Every row carries its sample size n; platforms that do not report the metric are listed in `availability`, never counted as 0. Pro plan or higher. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"query_insights"}.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/insights/query.)

dateTo.description: Format: string; e.g. "2026-11-20". ISO date or epoch ms.

filters.description: Format: object; e.g. {"labels":["campaign:summer"]}. Fields: labels, excludeLabels, campaignId, experimentId, platforms.

formula.description: Format: object; e.g. {"series":{"A":{"metric":"impressions"… Fields: series, expression, format.

metric.description: Format: string; e.g. "impressions". Metric to measure. One of 19 values, e.g. "impressions", "views", "engagement".

name: query_insights
title: Run a custom insight query
